audience: Young men and women interested in dating, money and lifestyle; both creators' followers.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption says it is a conversation between two friends that got 'disgusting' (they forgot they were in front of a camera) and lists the episode questions (relationship or sleeping around, stock market or business, leaving home, does money make you happy); the video indeed opens on a crude joke but shifts to the 'women are attracted to traits, not money' point and a title card announcing the date. The cover is a designed face-to-face poster of the two men with 'דניאל דמארי X מתן ניסטור'.
